data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month and propose individual opt-ins, not unanimity. Each switch from 10 to 18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and all others 10, catch=250+8k; remaining=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). All 25 at 18 leave 50; next stock is 500 or 100—not risk-free or guaranteed best long-run. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches need recalculation. Each of you: state your exact intended catch and whether it depends on others.
